entities.name: A0A1B0GUA5
observations: Reviewed human small integral membrane protein 32; exact full-length sequence match to the query (103 aa, 100% identity and coverage).
Annotated as a single-pass membrane protein localized to the membrane.
Sequence contains one prominent hydrophobic segment approximately residues 60–82, consistent with a membrane-spanning helix; the N-terminal region is nonhydrophobic and likely extramembrane.

entities.name: Single-pass membrane localization
observations: The query is most likely an integral membrane protein with one transmembrane helix, rather than a soluble protein or a protein with an N-terminal cleavable signal peptide.
The short N-terminal domain precedes the hydrophobic helix, with a short C-terminal tail following it; precise sidedness is not established from the available evidence.
